title: Congee (Rice Porridge)
description: Silky long-simmered rice porridge in vegetable broth, crowned with crispy paprika tempeh, edamame, bok choy, bamboo shoots and a shower of sesame seeds. Cozy, savory and endlessly customizable.
swaps: Use tamari instead of soy sauce (both in the tempeh and for serving).
watch: Check the tempeh label: some multigrain tempeh contains barley or other gluten grains, so buy plain soy tempeh marked gluten-free. Use a gluten-free vegetable broth.

title: Millet Porridge with Apples and Pear
description: Fluffy millet simmered with cinnamon and plant milk, then folded with tender apple and pear and a little maple. A naturally gluten-free, oat-free alternative to oatmeal that keeps well all week.
swaps: Use the oat or soy milk option, not almond milk.

title: Pineapple Buckwheat Pancakes with Coconut Cream
time: about 20 min (plus chilling the coconut cream)
description: Nutty buckwheat-banana pancakes studded with juicy pineapple and stacked with whipped coconut cream, peaches and more pineapple. A tropical brunch stack that needs only one flax egg.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk instead of almond milk.
watch: Buy buckwheat flour labeled gluten-free (buckwheat is often processed alongside wheat).

title: Chickpea Shakshuka
description: A one-skillet shakshuka of peppers, garlic and smoky spiced tomatoes, packed with chickpeas and briny kalamata olives. Bring the pan straight to the table with fresh herbs and sesame seeds.
swaps: Serve with gluten-free bread instead of naan/pita/baguette. Skip the vegan fried eggs, or top with seared tofu rounds instead.
watch: If you make or buy the vegan fried eggs from the recipe notes, check every ingredient for wheat and nut-based products.

title: Vegan Dutch Baby Pancake
description: A big, golden skillet pancake baked with berries and finished with fresh fruit and pomegranate. It's egg-free, and it makes a showy centerpiece for a brunch table.
swaps: Use the gluten-free flour option (a 1:1 blend without almond flour), soy or oat milk, and coconut oil instead of vegan butter.
watch: Choose a gluten-free 1:1 blend with no almond flour. The gluten-free version is an author-listed option, so expect a slightly denser, less puffy result than the wheat original.

title: Perfect Oat Flour Pancakes
description: Tender, fluffy pancakes made by blitzing rolled oats into flour, with a flax egg and a 'buttermilk' of soy milk and vinegar. Simple pantry ingredients, and they taste like a classic diner stack.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free oats. Cook in oil instead of vegan butter, or use a nut-free vegan butter.
watch: Oats must be certified gluten-free. Many vegan butters are cashew- or almond-based, so check the label.

title: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
description: Crispy cubes of sweet potato tossed with bell peppers, red onion, jalapeño, garlic and black beans in smoky paprika. Pile on sliced avocado for a filling one-pan breakfast.

title: Instant Pot Teff Porridge
description: Whole-grain teff cooks into a creamy, cocoa-dark porridge with a natural malty-nutty taste. Finish it with cinnamon, maple, flax, chopped dates and fresh banana or mango.
swaps: Replace the chopped pecans with toasted pumpkin seeds. Use oat or soy milk.
watch: Buy teff labeled gluten-free.

title: Creamy Amaranth Porridge with Coconut Milk
description: Tiny amaranth grains simmer into a thick, pudding-like porridge scented with cardamom and enriched with coconut milk. Serve topped with sliced pears.
swaps: Replace the chopped pecans with pumpkin or sunflower seeds.

title: Vegan Polenta Frittata
description: Cheesy-tasting polenta (thanks to nutritional yeast) baked into sliceable wedges, loaded with garlicky mushrooms, cherry tomatoes and fresh basil. It's egg-free and soy-free, and it looks good on a brunch table.
watch: Use a gluten-free vegetable broth and polenta labeled gluten-free.

title: Easy Baked Chickpea Frittata
description: A light, fluffy, egg-free frittata from a chickpea-flour batter with a little rice flour and kala namak for an eggy taste. It bakes into tidy slices you can fill with whatever vegetables you have.

title: Yellow Split Pea Coconut Breakfast Porridge
description: A savory, dal-inspired breakfast bowl of split peas, carrots, ginger, turmeric and mustard seeds, finished with coconut milk and lime. Spoon it over brown rice with scallions, cilantro and avocado.
swaps: Use the coconut milk, not the cashew cream alternative.

title: Matcha Mochi Waffles
description: Crisp outside and bouncy-chewy inside, these glutinous-rice-flour waffles get earthy color from matcha and richness from coconut milk. Fun to make for a brunch party.
swaps: Use a gluten-free flour blend without almond flour. Use coconut yogurt or coconut cream.
watch: Glutinous (sweet) rice flour is naturally gluten-free despite the name.

title: Tamagoyaki Scramble (Vegan Japanese Scrambled Eggs)
description: Yuba and silken tofu whisked with mirin, dashi and black salt for soft, sweet-savory curds in the style of Japanese tamagoyaki. Finish with nori, scallions and sesame and serve over rice.
swaps: Use tamari instead of soy sauce. Use soy or oat milk (not cashew), and chickpea or rice flour.
watch: Check the kombu dashi granules, mirin and vegan Kewpie-style mayo labels for wheat. Some dashi granules contain fish, which is fine for her.

title: Vegan Coffee Cake (Gluten-Free, Oil-Free)
description: A tender oat-flour and tapioca coffee cake made moist with coconut milk and applesauce, under a brown-sugar crumb topping. It makes an easy sweet square for a brunch spread.
swaps: Replace the 1/4 cup walnuts in the streusel with pumpkin seeds or extra certified gluten-free rolled oats.
watch: The oat flour must be from certified gluten-free oats.

title: Allergy Free Waffles
description: Crisp, vanilla-scented waffles that are top-8 free as written, made with a flax egg, a gluten-free all-purpose flour and plant milk. Make a full batch and freeze the extras for the toaster.
watch: Use a gluten-free all-purpose blend with xanthan gum and no almond flour. Use gluten-free oat or rice milk as the author does.

title: Allergen Friendly Funfetti Pancakes
description: Birthday-party pancakes flecked with rainbow sprinkles and mini chocolate chips, made with flax eggs and a 1:1 gluten-free flour. A festive stack for kids' brunches.
watch: Check the sprinkles label (some contain wheat starch or dairy) and use dairy-free chocolate chips. Use a gluten-free 1:1 flour without almond flour.

title: Peaches and Cream Chia Pudding
description: Rich coconut-milk chia pudding layered with fresh peaches and peach jam, like a peaches-and-cream parfait. Assemble the jars the night before brunch.
watch: Use a gluten-free oat milk, as the author suggests.

title: Nut-Free Granola Bars
description: Chewy oat bars with crispy rice, sweetened with brown rice syrup (or honey) and topped with mini chocolate chips. They're school-safe and nut-free, and they pack well for busy mornings.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free rolled oats and oat flour, gluten-free crispy brown rice cereal, and dairy-free chocolate chips.
watch: Regular Rice Krispies contain malt flavoring (barley), so use a certified gluten-free crisp rice cereal. Oats must be certified gluten-free.

title: Overnight Mango Banana Chia Pudding with Coconut Milk
description: A tropical chia pudding blended with mango, banana and coconut milk, then topped with more mango and toasted coconut. It keeps up to five days in the fridge.

title: Savory Oatmeal Breakfast Burrito Bowl
description: Burrito-bowl flavors on a savory base: spiced sweet potato, black beans and wilted spinach over cilantro grains, with a cumin-lime yogurt drizzle. Garnish with jalapeño and scallions.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free rolled oats instead of the branded grain cereal. Use plain coconut yogurt. Skip the fried egg, or top with a tofu scramble as the author suggests.
watch: Oats must be certified gluten-free.

title: Creamy Breakfast Vegan Rice Pudding
description: Leftover brown rice blended and warmed with plant milk, banana, cinnamon, nutmeg and citrus zest into a comforting breakfast pudding. There's an optional cocoa version too.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk as the non-dairy milk.

title: Superfood Sweet Potato Hash
description: An AIP/Whole30-friendly skillet of bacon, caramelized sweet potato, onion, garlic and sliced chicken sausage, wilted with a pile of baby kale and seasoned with turmeric and thyme. A meaty breakfast that needs no grains.
swaps: Omit the runny-egg topping (avocado and green onion are enough).
watch: Check the bacon and pre-cooked chicken sausage labels for wheat, dairy (some sausages contain cheese) or fillers.

title: Dosai (Bean and Rice Crepes)
time: about 30 min active (plus 8 hr soak and 8–12 hr ferment)
description: Classic South Indian dosai: soaked urad dal and rice ground and fermented into a tangy batter, then swirled into lacy, crisp crepes. Eat them plain with chutney or wrap them around a spiced potato filling.
swaps: Brush with oil, not ghee (the recipe's own milk-free substitution).

title: Breakfast or Country Sausage
description: Homemade sage-and-pepper pork breakfast sausage with a little cayenne and nutmeg, made from just pork and spices with no fillers. Shape it into patties or links and freeze the extra.
watch: Buy plain fresh pork. Some pre-packaged pork has added solutions, so check the label.

title: Pesarattu (Green Moong Dal Dosa)
description: An Andhra breakfast crepe made from soaked whole green mung beans ground with chilies, ginger and cumin, with no fermenting needed. It's crisp, high in protein and topped with chopped onion.

title: Poha (Kanda Batata Poha)
description: Flattened rice flakes tossed with onion, potato, curry leaves, mustard seeds and turmeric, then brightened with lemon and cilantro. A light, fragrant Indian breakfast ready in minutes.
swaps: Omit the peanuts (do not use the cashew option). Add toasted pumpkin seeds for crunch.
watch: Hing (asafoetida) is often cut with wheat flour, so use a certified gluten-free hing or leave it out.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Granola
description: A simple, clumpy maple-cinnamon granola baked low and slow with coconut oil. Spoon it over coconut yogurt or eat it by the handful.
swaps: Replace the pecans with a mix of pumpkin and sunflower seeds.
watch: Oats must be certified gluten-free.

title: Tofu Tacos with Black Beans
description: Spiced tofu scramble with peppers, corn, black beans and spinach, piled into warm corn tortillas with guacamole and cilantro. A taco bar that feeds a crowd at brunch.
watch: Use 100% corn tortillas (some 'corn' tortillas include wheat flour).

title: Smoothie Bowl
description: A thick, spoonable berry-banana smoothie bowl with a handful of spinach blended in. Top it with fresh berries, banana, granola and chia seeds.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk instead of almond milk. Use sunflower seed butter instead of almond/peanut butter (in the bowl and the drizzle). Top with nut-free certified gluten-free granola.
watch: If you add protein powder, check it for dairy (whey) and nut ingredients.
